message:
The device must Convert sunlight to wire power, Store energy for night use, Remove heat from air and produce, Enclose chamber against heat and wind, Hold produce for access, and Regulate temperature to setpoint, with sun to electricity to cold air to crates as the kept chain. Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Enclosure and Structural Designer, Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the kept selections still stand as grown split array with battery bank with monoblock cooling with insulated box with racked crates with probe control, because the principle of sun power to stored charge to vapour-compression cold air near 5 degrees Celsius holds at everyday scale for 1 000 kg of produce in 8.64 cubic metres from the interior volume estimate (E39).

Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer you will close the first open energy request by calc with a term-by-term electrical sum naming conduction plus respiration plus fans plus door plus staged pull-down divided by Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electric power) plus controls, Solar Energy Systems Engineer you will close the second open storage request by simulate with 24-hour charge state including start surge and one cloudy day, Enclosure and Structural Designer you will close the third open support request by calc with a complete mass sum and pad pressure and screw-anchor capacity and close the layout part of the fourth open detail request by sketch, and Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer you will close the datasheet part of that fourth request by search for monoblock capacity and COP at 43 degrees Celsius ambient. In plain words one owner must own one total so margins can be judged, with the grown yield 13.5 kilowatt-hour per day from the grown-array yield calc (E83) set against a single reconciled electrical load that supersedes the inconsistent 13.2 kilowatt-hour per day from the steady plus staged pull-down estimate (E58) and the 14.8 kilowatt-hour per day implied by 615 watt average from the revised steady-load simulation (E28).

Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist you will own the about 1 tonne constraint by calc for 50 crates at 20 kg from the total produce mass estimate (E49) and the crates for 1 tonne check (E77), Solar Energy Systems Engineer you will own the solar-only constraint by calc and simulate for Photovoltaic (PV, solar electricity) yield at 5.00 Peak Sun Hours with 0.75 derate from the grown-array yield calc (E83), Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer you will own heating and filling behaviour over time by simulate for staged 250 kg per day pull-down reusing the revised steady-load simulation (E28) unless you state why you recompute, and Enclosure and Structural Designer you will own tipping and uplift behaviour by calc reusing the wind uplift mass equivalent (E90) at 673 kg which is about nine adults so anchoring matters. In plain words no second value for the same duty will stand, with door 0.44 kilowatt-hour per day from the door infiltration estimate (E57) against the larger simulation door term and full-tonne 25.0 kilowatt-hour from the recomputed pull-down estimate (E26) against the erroneous earlier total reconciled by joint confirmation of adjacent owners before agreement.

Note on Solar Energy Systems Engineer: yield and autonomy ownership is with you pending consistent electrical load.
Note on Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer: thermal to electrical conversion and hot-ambient capacity ownership is with you pending COP proof.
Note on Enclosure and Structural Designer: complete mass and pressure and anchorage and dimensioned crate layout ownership is with you pending joint confirmation.
Note on Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist: tonne count and staged intake and door discipline ownership is with you pending full-load rule.
My position is not ready, because the four open requests leave daily electrical balance, night autonomy, complete mass, and layout proof unsettled.
